entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: A middle-aged man is fighting[n]alone against a sea of enemies.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: What do you think of that?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: If you think you should maybe[n]save him, come back to the store.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Something happen to you? Don't[n]be afraid to come back, OK?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I'll be counting on you.[n]Don't stop for any detours[n]on your way back.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What are you going to do? Will you[n]accept the chief's invitation?
